What is Vessla? Vessla is the agentic operating system for property operations. It connects the property business in one shared context, where agents and people run work together across systems, documents and stakeholders. Is Vessla just another automation tool? No. Vessla is an operating layer for the whole property business. Agents read shared context from every system and document, do the operational work, and people review and decide. Who is Vessla for? Property owners and leaders of property or facility management teams who are accountable for portfolio performance, service quality and team capacity. Does Vessla replace our existing systems? No. Vessla runs above your systems of record, bringing together M365 email, SharePoint and Teams, PMS, ERP and CRM systems, phone conversations, contracts and documents. How do people stay in control? Agents prepare and perform the work, while people set direction, review key decisions and remain accountable for outcomes. Human review is built into how work moves forward. How do we get started? Book a demo to see Vessla in action, or request a pilot to put agents to work on part of your portfolio.
